phase: Phase 1: Page B in the preview folder (by Wed 2026-11-18)
summary: Round 3 closes C2-1 to C2-8 for the tested cases: preview.sh resolves paths before the cd, copies docs before real-work.ts, and keeps the usage and refusal contract; no blocker remains. Six minor or nit items stay open and do not block the phase.
contract_applicability: applicable: test-strategy.md section 9, Phase 1 row assigns Review C the CLI exit codes of real-work.ts, preview.sh, and publish.ts, and the phase adds new data files and a new page.
nonblocking_findings: C3-1 [Minor] review-c: harness/model-guide/preview.sh:75-89: The docs copy now runs before the input check. When the preview folder already exists (the default folder in the second weekly run) and real-work.ts refuses, the script keeps the folder (preview.sh:85) and the docs overlay stays in it: docs/index.html overwrites the preview index.html with its nav links, and the old preview-base.json stays. Header lines 13-14 promise only `no new preview folder`, and test F19 (preview-gate.test.ts:874) covers a new folder only. Publish stays safe (a SHA-256 or drift refusal follows), but a refused run changes an old preview. Fix: run real-work.ts into a temp folder first, then copy docs and move the files; add a test with an existing preview folder and a refused input. By code trace; my temp-copy probe was blocked by the sandbox.

C3-2 [Minor] review-c: harness/model-guide/preview.sh:136: The nav insert has no check for links that exist. After the first publish, docs/index.html holds the `Real work` and `Review` links (test p5 publishes index.html). The next preview then inserts both links a second time, and an approved index.html would publish a doubled nav. No test covers a second run on a published index. Fix: skip the insert when `./real-work.html` is in the file. By code trace.

C3-3 [Nit] review-c: harness/model-guide/real-work.ts:178-185: C2-6 is closed for a missing key (REQUIRED_COVERAGE_KEYS, real-work.ts:36-43, tests F17) but only paired_duplicates_left_out has a type check. A string in share_known_route, a number in first_run_date, or a missing source.generated_on (real-work.ts:355) passes the schema check and then raises a Python traceback in preview.sh:233-247 with exit 1. The preview then holds real-work.json and no real-work.html. The export is SHA-256 pinned, so the risk is low. Check the types, or state the limit in the header.

C3-4 [Nit] review-c: harness/model-guide/real-work.ts:167,178: An input file that is missing (with a MANIFEST.txt present), unreadable, not JSON, or the JSON value `null` raises an uncaught exception: exit 1 with a stack trace and no `input-check:` line. FR-1 names four checks (SHA-256, size, schema, run sum), so this is outside its list, but the CLI contract elsewhere is exit 0 or 2. Map a parse failure and a missing input file to `input-check: schema` and `input-check: manifest`. By code trace; probe blocked.

C3-5 [Nit] review-c: harness/model-guide/publish.ts:105-116 versus publish.ts:16-19: The header and the test header place the folder check in step 4, before every SHA-256 check. The code checks each row in turn (folder, then SHA-256). With row 1 a wrong SHA-256 and row 2 a folder, the code prints `publish: sha256 <row 1>` where the header says `publish: bad path <row 2>`. The test header (preview-gate.test.ts:62-72) also omits the folder rule and the bad line step. Both exit 2 with no write, so no user harm. Split the loops or fix the header.

C3-6 [Nit] review-c: harness/model-guide/publish.ts:120-126: A preview-base.json that holds the JSON value `null` parses without error, and `base.docs` at publish.ts:126 raises TypeError: exit 1 with a stack trace, no write. F23 covers invalid JSON only (preview-gate.test.ts:944). Add `base === null || typeof base !== "object"` to the `publish: bad preview base` path. By code trace.

Streams and exit codes after the fix: refusals print one line on stdout with exit 2 in all three tools (preview.sh:54, real-work.ts:46, publish.ts:40); usage errors print one line on stderr, keep stdout empty, and exit 2 (preview.sh:24, real-work.ts:80 and :85, publish.ts:50). No refusal writes under docs/ or to a new file: preview.sh refuses a path before mkdir (preview.sh:75), real-work.ts refuses before mkdirSync (real-work.ts:363), publish.ts runs every check before the copy loop (publish.ts:145). The exception is an existing preview folder (C3-1).

Caller wiring: preview.sh passes `--input <abs>` and `--out <abs>` to real-work.ts (preview.sh:80); real-work.ts parseArgs (real-work.ts:68-89) accepts both and exits 2 on any other flag. The exit status of real-work.ts passes through at preview.sh:83-89. The python step receives MODEL_GUIDE_ROOT, MODEL_GUIDE_PREVIEW, and MODEL_GUIDE_TEMPLATE (preview.sh:91-93) and reads the same names. publish.ts takes `--preview <folder>` only and preview.sh never calls it.

The six PRODUCER, CHECKER, SOURCE, COVERAGE, WORK-TYPES and PRINT-AUDIT tokens are replaced at preview.sh:255-266 and the template is unchanged in the range.
Approval record: the checks need only the files section. No check of approved_by or date is needed (spec.md:780-783, :858); I report no finding for the consent fields.
